issue_context.title: Xiaomi Aqara: Non-thread-safe operation invoked on an event loop other than the current one
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Since updating to April release of Home Assistant I have been experiencing random crashes of HA without recovery. More details [here](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/91207).

After adding `debugpy:` to configuration.yaml I am now seeing following on repeat:

```

Traceback (most recent call last):

    await self.async_device_update()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 781, in async_device_update
    await hass.async_add_executor_job(self.update)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/concurrent/futures/thread.py", line 58, in run
    result = self.fn(*self.args, **self.kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/xiaomi_aqara/binary_sensor.py", line 159, in update
    self._get_from_hub(self._sid)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/xiaomi_gateway/__init__.py", line 444, in get_from_hub
    return self.push_data(resp)

    func(jdata, data)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/xiaomi_aqara/__init__.py", line 358, in push_data
    was_unavailable = self._async_track_unavailable()
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/xiaomi_aqara/__init__.py", line 346, in _async_track_unavailable
    self._remove_unavailability_tracker = async_track_point_in_utc_time(
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/event.py", line 1349, in async_track_point_in_utc_time
    cancel_callback = hass.loop.call_later(delta, run_action, job)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/asyncio/base_events.py", line 721, in call_later
    timer = self.call_at(self.time() + delay, callback, *args,
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/asyncio/base_events.py", line 734, in call_at
    self._check_thread()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/asyncio/base_events.py", line 792, in _check_thread
    raise RuntimeError(
RuntimeError: Non-thread-safe operation invoked on an event loop other than the current one
```
